recorded.letter:
**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** June 9, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for continuous glucose monitoring has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**Diagnosis Requirement:** Patient has an active diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia, established May 27, 2022 (ICD-10: E11.65).

**Medical Necessity:** Patient demonstrates recurrent Level 2 hypoglycemic events (glucose <54 mg/dL) despite multiple medication adjustments. Three documented readings below threshold occurred on April 19, 2025 (45 mg/dL), April 25, 2025 (51 mg/dL), and May 9, 2025 (42 mg/dL). Glipizide dose was reduced in March 2025, then discontinued and replaced with sitagliptin in May 2025; hypoglycemic episodes persist despite these interventions.

**Practitioner Visit:** Patient had a telehealth diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. S. Mehta on February 1, 2025, within the required 6-month window. The visit note documents assessment of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, with continuous glucose monitoring discussed.

This authorization is valid for one year from the order date.
